title: Soil Movement by Community for Crack Reinspections — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Cedar Hollow, Larkspur Meadows and Sierra Vista Ranch are built on expansive clay. The visit charge of a re-measurement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a soil-movement multiplier, applied to the program's reinspection fee.

**Rule.** The soil-movement multiplier reads the item's defect category together with the community named on the home's Home Purchase Agreement: a concrete flatwork, foundation slab or masonry veneer item in Cedar Hollow, Larkspur Meadows or Sierra Vista Ranch, which are built on expansive clay, takes 0.70; a concrete flatwork, foundation slab or masonry veneer item in Mesquite Trails, Brookstone Crossing or Willow Bend Reserve takes 0.85; any other item takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Item's defect category | Cedar Hollow, Larkspur Meadows, Sierra Vista Ranch | Mesquite Trails, Brookstone Crossing, Willow Bend Reserve | Any other community |
|---|---|---|---|
| concrete flatwork | 0.70 | 0.85 | 1.00 |
| foundation slab | 0.70 | 0.85 | 1.00 |
| masonry veneer | 0.70 | 0.85 | 1.00 |
| any other category (drywall included) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

**Reading the sheet.** The community is the one named on the Home Purchase Agreement under which Calloway sold the home that carries the coverage; the category is that of the re-measured claim item as filed. A drywall crack re-measured in Sierra Vista Ranch takes 1.00, while a foundation slab crack in Brookstone Crossing takes 0.85.
